cases.situation: I paid for my friend Leo's Taylor Swift ticket 3 weeks ago, $186. He said he'd Venmo me 'this week' and hasn't. We're close and I don't want it weird.
cases.reply: Hey, whenever you're near your phone: $186 for the Eras ticket, I'm @maya-chen on Venmo. Just so it doesn't slip for either of us!
cases.note: The number, what it was for and how to pay. No story, no hint. He almost certainly forgot.

cases.situation: 去年借给大学同学小赵8000块，说好半年还，现在一年了他一直没提。我这两个月要交房租押金，确实需要这笔钱。
cases.reply: 小赵，跟你说个事哈：去年借你的那8000块，我这边11月初要交新房子的押金，想看看能不能在10月底前先还一部分？分两次也完全没问题，你看怎么方便，给我个大概时间就行。
cases.note: 数目、用途、截止时间都围绕自己的需要来说，不翻旧账也不评价对方，并主动给分期的台阶。

cases.situation: My friend Jade keeps asking me to book concert and brunch stuff on my card and then pays late or forgets. She just asked me to put the $140 festival tickets on my card again.
cases.reply: I can't front it this time, I'm keeping things tight this month. The presale opens Thursday at 10, want to both jump on at the same time and grab tickets next to each other?
cases.note: When it's a pattern, the fix is to stop fronting money, not a sharper reminder. Keep the plan, drop the float.

cases.situation: I reminded my friend Priya about the $64 she owes for her share of the Airbnb in Asheville and she replied 'wow, you're really chasing me over $64?' Not sure how to answer without it turning into a thing.
cases.reply: Ha, fair, it's not a lot, which is exactly why I'd like to get it off the list. My Venmo is @tess-marlow whenever you're ready. Looking forward to tacos on Saturday.
cases.note: When they get defensive, agree it's small, repeat the ask once and don't explain your finances. If it still doesn't come, decide whether to write it off for real.

cases.situation: 国庆和大学室友四个人去成都自驾，我订了民宿和租车，一共先垫了5,600。想在群里提前把怎么AA说清楚，别回来再算不清。
cases.reply: 来对个账～民宿3晚3,800，租车1,800，一共5,600，四个人每人1,400。大家出发前（10月1号前）微信转我就行。路上油费和过路费谁付谁记在群里，回来再一起算。
cases.note: Settling the split before the trip, with the number and a date, prevents most of the awkwardness afterwards.

cases.situation: 上个月找好朋友阿杰借了3,000块周转，说好9月底还。结果公司工资推迟到10月15号才发，这周还不上。他还没催我，我想主动跟他说。
cases.reply: 阿杰，那3,000块说好这周还你，但公司这个月工资推迟到10月15号发，我得晚两周。15号到账当天我就转给你。拖了真不好意思，要是你这几天急用，跟我说一声，我先想办法凑一部分给你。
cases.note: 欠钱的一方要在对方开口前主动说，给确定日期，并给对方说急需的空间。

cases.situation: My roommate Kai and I split utilities 50/50. The electric bill for August and September came to $236 and it came out of my account. I want to ask for his $118 and also suggest a setup so I'm not the one chasing every month.
cases.reply: Hey Kai, the electric bill for August and September came in at $236, so your half is $118. My Venmo's @ana-ruiz, anytime this week works. Going forward, want to both put $150 into a shared bills account on the 1st? Then neither of us has to chase the other.
cases.note: Number, what it was for and how to pay, then a system proposed up front, which prevents the next awkward reminder better than any wording.

cases.situation: I lent my friend Marco $200 back in April for a car repair. He just got laid off and I've decided I don't want the money back. I want to tell him so he stops feeling bad about it.
cases.reply: Hey Marco, about the $200 from April: please forget it, we're square. You've bailed me out more times than I can count, and you've got enough on your plate right now. Beers are on me Friday if you're up for it.
cases.note: Writing it off works only if you actually let it go: say it once, clearly, and never mention the amount again.

cases.situation: Mon pote Hugo, qu'on connaît depuis la fac, me demande de lui prêter 800 euros pour la caution de son nouvel appart. Je ne peux pas, je rembourse encore mon prêt étudiant, et je ne veux pas que ça crée un malaise entre nous.
cases.reply: Trop content pour l'appart, Hugo ! Pour les 800 euros, je ne peux pas, je rembourse encore mon prêt étudiant et je n'ai pas cette marge en ce moment. Par contre, regarde l'avance Loca-Pass d'Action Logement, ça sert justement à avancer le dépôt de garantie et tu y as peut-être droit. Et samedi je suis dispo avec la voiture pour le déménagement.
cases.note: Un non clair avec une seule raison courte, sans détailler ses finances, puis une aide concrète qui ne coûte pas d'argent.

cases.situation: I bought the joint 30th birthday present for our friend Sophie, a £240 weekender bag, split six ways at £40 each. Four people paid within a day. Josh hasn't, two weeks later. I don't want to call him out in the group chat.
cases.reply: Hey Josh, for Sophie's bag: it came to £240, so £40 each. My details are sort code 20-45-77, account 41558203. I'm clearing it off my card this weekend, so before Saturday would be great. Hope the new job's going well!
cases.note: Chase group-gift stragglers one at a time, in private, with the number and how to pay; never in the group chat.

cases.situation: 下周六10月10日和大学同学六个人聚餐，每次都AA。上次他们点了两瓶红酒一千多，我不喝酒也跟着均摊了。这次想提前在群里说，酒水单独算。
cases.reply: 周六见！提前说个小事：我不喝酒，这次酒水能不能喝的人单独分，饭菜还是六个人AA？我来负责结账，吃完在群里发明细，大家转我就行。
cases.note: 饭前定规则比买单时再算轻松得多；只讲办法，不翻上次的账，自己揽下结账让大家更容易同意。

cases.situation: I lent my friend Theo my camera for his trip to Iceland and he dropped it. The lens repair quote is $210. At the time he said he'd pay 'whatever it costs', but it's been three weeks and he hasn't mentioned it.
cases.reply: Hey Theo, got the repair quote back for the lens: $210 at Kelso Camera, invoice attached. Venmo is easiest, I'm @maya-lin. I'd like to book the repair before my shoot on the 17th, so sometime next week would be great. The glacier shots came out amazing, by the way.
cases.note: Sending the invoice makes the number a fact rather than a judgement about the accident, and the deadline is about your shoot, not his lapse.

cases.situation: Since his promotion my friend Dan grabs the bill every time we go out. He's paid the last four dinners, around $300 in total, and it's starting to feel uneven. I'd like to pay for dinner this Friday without making it a big deal.
cases.reply: Heads up for Friday: dinner's on me this time, no arguments. You've got the last four and I'd like to keep it even so I can keep saying yes. If you really insist we can split it, but you're not getting the whole bill.
cases.note: Money awkwardness runs both ways: when a friend keeps paying, say plainly what you'll do and keep it light, without a speech about fairness.

cases.situation: 发小阿斌想开一家奶茶店，找我借两万块，说一年内还。我手头有这笔钱，也愿意帮他，但想把怎么还说清楚，最好写个借条，又怕他觉得我不信任他。
cases.reply: 阿斌，两万我可以借你，开店是好事，我挺支持的。为了咱俩都省心，把还款说清楚：从明年3月开始每月还2,000，10个月还完，你看行不行？我顺手写了个简单的借条，写上金额和还款安排，签个字各留一份，不是不信你，是这样以后谁都不用记。店开起来我第一个去喝。
cases.note: 只借自己亏得起的钱；借条当成办事流程来提，语气放轻，重点放在还款安排上。

cases.situation: I organised a cabin weekend for six friends and asked everyone for $210 in the group chat. Everyone paid, and now I've realised I counted the $150 cleaning fee twice, so each person overpaid $25.
cases.reply: Cabin money update: I messed up the maths and counted the $150 cleaning fee twice, so everyone overpaid by $25. I'm sending each of you $25 back tonight through the same app you paid me on. Shout if it hasn't arrived by tomorrow. Sorry about that, and thanks for paying so fast!
cases.note: When the error is yours, the same rules apply in reverse: the exact number, how it's coming back, and when, with no drawn-out apology.

cases.situation: 朋友小周五月让我帮她垫了演唱会票1,280元，7月和8月我各提醒过一次，她都说“下周转你”，到现在也没转。这已经是她第三次让我垫钱了。我决定这笔不追了，但以后不想再帮她垫。
cases.reply: 小周，演唱会票那1,280块我就不追了，这事就算过去了，以后我也不会再提。以后一起买票或者订东西，咱们各订各的、各付各的，我这样比较轻松，不是生你的气。
cases.note: 提醒两次都没结果时，要么真正放下，要么说清楚不再垫钱；这里两件一起说，只说一次，不翻旧账。
